scoring_justification: Limiting potentials are the end result of a full DFT+CHE pipeline; the verifier sandbox cannot rerun DFT, so the checker compares the agent's reported UL values to paper gold within tolerance and checks the required ordering trend.

outputs.description: Computed limiting potentials (UL) and the largest free‑energy step (ΔGmax) for NRR on six catalyst models; the checker recomputes agreement with reference values and the required ordering (F‑Fe@F‑G must show the highest UL).

output_contract.notes: Binding energies, N₂ adsorption energies, and H* adsorption energies are computed as intermediates inside the process steps but are not scored separately.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference limiting potentials (UL) for six catalyst systems and the required ordering (F‑Fe@F‑G must have the highest UL)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper supplementary Table S1/S2; values: Fe -0.72, F-Fe -0.54, Fe@G -0.83, Fe@F‑G -0.44, F-Fe@G -0.58, F-Fe@F‑G -0.36 V
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct copy from paper's reported UL values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own computed DFT+CHE limiting potentials, verified against the reference oracle solve.sh which writes the same numbers.
